summary: Review business cases, project risks, EVM signals, and benefits with practical governance exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Project management governance for senior officers involves reviewing mandates, business cases, delivery controls, and escalation evidence without taking over project management. Designed for sponsors, steering committee members, portfolio officers, and senior project managers, the course develops skills in clarifying decision rights, interpreting earned value and schedule or cost variances, assessing risk escalation, and turning status data into executive dashboards and action logs.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who review, sponsor, or govern projects and need to make sound decisions from business cases, delivery controls, and escalation reports.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project delivery terminology and responsibility for reviewing, sponsoring, or governing projects. No programming is required.
